policy_close.fix: Forward first queued Disconnect after input completion before propagating error or normal exit.

packet_path.finding: Owner fanout/mixed sends roughly twice as often per delivered message as retained implementation and uses smaller transmit batches. Same-image coalescing increases batching and reduces submissions per verified delivery. Sampled mutex acquisition wall-times are small in these captures; no proof of general lock or cache-coherence dominance.
packet_path.scope: Instrumented single diagnostic per case/arm; includes setup/teardown; systematic one-in256 span samples include preemption. Nested spans overlap and are not CPU-time attribution.
